basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Models one run of a test under frozen conditions, not the reusable test case or procedure.
Keeps expected result, observed result, comparison and verdict as separate assertions.
Snapshots subject, configuration, environment and equipment as they were at run time.
Links defects and nonconformities without owning them.

may: Execute automated steps and log them with timestamps.
Capture observations and raw evidence artifacts.
Compare observations with the oracle and propose a verdict.
Rerun an execution as a new record with lineage.
mustNot: Change a recorded result or evidence after the run.
Report a pass when steps were skipped or the environment was not qualified.
Use uncalibrated or out-of-date equipment without recording it.
Turn a single execution verdict into a certification or compliance claim.
Run tests on production systems or people without authorisation.
requiresHuman: Invalidating an execution or waiving a failed criterion.
Accepting results used for certification or safety release.

considerations: Falsified or careless test results can put unsafe products in people's hands.
Tests involving people or animals need ethical approval and consent.
Testers must be free to report failures without pressure.
affectedParties: End users of the tested product

items: A test execution has a test case reference, a subject version, an environment, a timestamp, an executor and a verdict.
It is confused with the test case, a test plan, a defect or a certification.
Unsafe release on false pass results.
Unrepeatable results when configuration was not frozen.
Damage to equipment or test subjects during destructive tests.
ISO 5725 accuracy of measurement methods and results.
